subject: integration
name: Uniswap
summary: Swaps Ether or a pinned token for a pinned token through the pools of Uniswap V3, on the person's own chain. Open source and signed locally; holds nothing for anyone. The price is read in one batched call through the person's Ethereum node. It stays at 3 because the router contract and the pools have not been judged as operations; it rises to 4 when an operation verdict for them says so. Judged here by its publisher.
